blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Here are INQToday’s top stories this afternoon: Former President Rodrigo Duterte will remain in detention at the International Criminal Court in The Hague after Trial Chamber III found no change in circumstances that would warrant his release. At the Sandiganbayan, a witness in the plunder case against Sen. Rodante Marcoleta told the Third Division that the P75-million donation linked to the case was intended for the senator’s 2025 senatorial campaign. The witness said the money came from three individuals and was campaign-related. Also, PhilHealth said hospital patients admitted for less than 24 hours may still qualify for inpatient […]...
